annotations.title: List value statistics for study fields

description: Discover valid values / enums for one or more study fields. Returns per-field value statistics — for each field: its type, unique-value count and topValues [{value, studiesCount}]. Great for finding valid enum values (e.g. OverallStatus, Phase) before building a filter. GET /stats/field/values.

fields.description: Field names to get value statistics for, e.g. ['OverallStatus','Phase'].

types.description: Restrict to fields of these value types (ENUM, STRING, DATE, INTEGER, NUMBER, BOOLEAN).

name: list_field_values
title: List value statistics for study fields
